thread:
sam (release): Heads up — we're seeing a steady 5-7% QPS drop on embeddings in prod eu-west1 since 09:04. Root looks like KV cache eviction racing with a mem reclaim path. Need an expedited hotfix deploy. short window (10m).

maya (sre): ack. can you paste the failing rollout image/sha? perf team already scoped impact: small but customer-facing. :frowning: planning to hold traffic if deploy risky.

sam (release): image: gcr.redwood-inference/internal/embed-service:2026-03-23-hotfix@sha256:3fa9b7c...
```
# proposed deploy command (deploy-bot)
/release deploy embed-service --image gcr...@sha256:3fa9b7c --canary=0 --window=10m --owner=sam
```

jen (oncall): can we skip canary? traffic shift for embeddings is noisy. if canary=0 we need 2 approvals from eng + sre per fast-path policy.

leo (eng): I can approve. patch reverts a single eviction path and adds a quick metric. unit/e2e passed on staging. patched kv cache flag = allow_fast_evict=false.

maya (sre): i need a quick smoke checklist: health check targets, rollback signal, and a way to pin back old image. also want release notes blurb for infra team.

sam (release): smoke: 1) 200 on /health 2) embed latency p50 within 5ms of baseline 3) kv-misses stable. rollback signal: >3% error or p95 > baseline + 120ms for 2 consecutive mins. rollback plan: image pin to previous sha256:a1b2c3d and traffic shift back.

leo (eng): agreed. I'll run the deploy if we get approvals.

maya (sre): approving for expedited path. +1 from SRE. :white_check_mark:

leo (eng): approving. +1 from ENG. :white_check_mark:

sam (release): @deploy-bot please run expedited deploy with canary skipped per opt-in. attaching release note snippet: "hotfix: kv cache eviction mitigated; no expected user-facing changes; monitors enabled."

releasebot: Deploy request received: embed-service image sha256:3fa9b7c. Policy: expedited-canary-skip requires 2 approvers (ENG, SRE) and oncall ack. Requirements satisfied. ETA to run: now.

deploy-bot: Starting deploy: embed-service -> image gcr.redwood-inference/internal/embed-service@sha256:3fa9b7c
- Canary: skipped (per expedited approval)
- Traffic shift: immediate
- Rollout id: rl-6990012345-1

deploy-bot: Post-deploy smoke steps triggered. Waiting for first 60s metric window...

maya (sre): watching. setting alert silence for noise for 10m.

jen (oncall): pulling logs: I see a small flurry of 429s at +15s but subsided. p50 looks good.

leo (eng): confirming new metric "kv_evict_inflight" is flat. Latency p95 within threshold.

maya (sre): passing first 2mins. no rollback triggers. continuing to monitor for full 10m.

sam (release): leaving note for release notes: "2026-03-23: hotfix deployed to eu-west1 to address kv cache eviction race; expedited rollout; monitoring enabled."

deploy-bot: Rollout complete. rl-6990012345-1 -> success.

sam (release): thanks everyone. follow-up: open a PR to add an automated canary guard to prevent 429 spikes on embed endpoints (low effort). tagging eng-triage. :sparkles:

leo (eng): will create PR this afternoon.

maya (sre): closing expedite channel — will leave monitors in watch mode for 24h. if regression re-op, we'll pin and rollback. good run. :thumbsup:
